items.title: Dillon Mitchell and Chris Cenac Jr. with back-to-back steals.
items.author: Bobby Krivitsky
items.body_excerpt:
Dillon Mitchell and Chris Cenac Jr. with back-to-back steals.

Mitchell finished his with a left-handed flush. Cenac muscles his way to a layup. 

Fun way for the Celtics' rookies to cap Boston's 114-93 preseason win over the Hornets. They improve to 3-0.
